name: PoleTestTreatProgramManager
tagline: Run the wood pole test & treat cycle – grade every pole, turn rejects into work orders, never miss a priority reject.
description: A complete pole inspection programme app for electric utilities in one PCF code component: schedule poles by circuit, assign inspection contractors, record sound & bore results with an indicative remaining-strength calculation, grade poles automatically into passed / reject / priority reject, decide steel-truss restoration or replacement, raise work orders with due dates by priority, remind joint-use transfers and follow progress and reject rates by circuit and contractor. Canvas apps, model-driven apps and a Power Pages contractor portal.
features: Remaining-strength estimate from circumference, shell and external decay
Automatic pass / reject / priority-reject grading with reasons
Work orders with due dates by priority, bulk raising
Progress and reject rate by circuit, install decade and contractor
Inspector / contractor role sees only own poles
Undo, CSV, work pack JSON, summary JSON
Power Fx outputs and six events
